verdict.rationale: NetHunt documents connecting ChatGPT, Claude, or any MCP-compatible assistant to the CRM, and a probe found a live OpenAPI spec. That means an agent has a first-party API/MCP path into the CRM. Nothing shows which operations that path exposes: creating a lead record, writing company data, or assigning an owner are not documented as agent-accessible actions. Owner reassignment and lead routing appear only as UI bulk-edit or automation features. missing for 10: documented MCP/API tools for record creation, company-data enrichment, and owner assignment; an end-to-end agent workflow example; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent enrich a new lead end-to-end via the API or MCP server — creating the record, filling company data, and assigning an owner

citations.quote: Connect ChatGPT, Claude, or any MCP-compatible assistant to NetHunt in a few clicks.
